query:
SELECT
                        u.unid,
                        u.username,
                        u.display_name,
                        u.bio,
                        u.created_at,
                        u.avatar_url,
                        u.banner_url,
                        EXISTS(
                            SELECT 1 FROM follows
                            WHERE follower_id = $2 AND following_id = u.unid
                        ) AS "is_following!: bool",
                        (u.unid = $2) AS "is_current_user!: bool"
                    FROM users u
                    WHERE u.username = $1
